title: Microsoft Purview Sensitivity Label
description: Represents a sensitivity label in the Microsoft Purview Information Protection service. Sensitivity labels classify and protect organizational data.

id.description: The unique identifier of the sensitivity label

name.description: The name of the sensitivity label

description.description: The description of the sensitivity label

color.description: The color associated with the label

sensitivity.description: The sensitivity order value, higher means more sensitive

tooltip.description: The tooltip text shown to users

isActive.description: Whether the label is currently active

isAppliable.description: Whether the label can be applied by users

contentFormats.description: The content formats the label applies to

hasProtection.description: Whether the label applies protection (encryption, rights management)
